name: Photos
description: Browse, organize, and caption your photo library.

fileAccess.rationale: Photos app stores raster images and writes EXIF/dimensions extracted from uploaded image files into the image metadata table.

labelKeys.description: This image is a re-sized thumbnail of its parent record, not a photo the user uploaded. Other image apps can filter these out.
This image is a user-made crop of its parent record.

A person the user has named in this photo. Multi-valued: one row per named person, so ?label=photos/faces&labelValue=Alice finds every photo of Alice. Written only when on-device face recognition is enabled AND the user opts in to publishing; unnamed clusters are never published.
How many faces on-device detection found in this photo, as a small integer. Absent (never zero) when there are none, so ?label=photos/face-count means 'has at least one face'.

A tag the user has confirmed or typed on this photo. Multi-valued: one row per tag, so ?label=photos/tags&labelValue=the%20beach finds every photo the user agreed is a beach. Only user-confirmed tags are published — machine suggestions are not, because their similarity scores are uncalibrated and must not become another app's ground truth.
